neighbours.label: Mass/weight unit tokens right after a number, mainly kg / kilograms (also lbs, pounds, gallon, Cyrillic кг/килограмм), especially in body or animal weight statements
fire: Adult male gorillas typically weigh around 160 kg, while females are considerably lighter.
The boxer had to cut down to 72 kg before the official weigh-in on Friday.
Each shipping crate holds up to 500 kg of grain and must be inspected at the port.
My suitcase came in at 23 kg, exactly the airline limit for checked luggage.
The newborn calf weighed 40 kg and was standing within an hour of birth.
At the clinic they measured me: weight 61 kg, height 170 cm, blood pressure normal.
The rower trained all winter to stay under 70kg for the lightweight category.
A full-grown sack of potatoes can weigh nearly 25 kilograms, so lift it carefully.
quiet: Adult male gorillas are much larger and heavier than the females in their troop.
The boxer spent weeks dieting before the official weigh-in on Friday.
Each shipping crate must be inspected at the port before it can be loaded.
The airline changed its luggage rules again, and nobody at the counter understood them.
The newborn calf was standing within an hour of birth, wobbly but determined.
At the clinic they asked about my diet, my sleep, and how often I exercise.
The trail runs for about twelve miles along the ridge before dropping to the lake.
She bought three new books and a lamp for her reading corner last weekend.

notes: Label and sentences written blind by a Claude subagent from the card text alone (prompt: haiku_labeler/prompt.md, identical for Haiku, Sonnet and Opus); one retry on mechanical checks. Part of a Haiku/Sonnet/Opus comparison on the same 48 poles.
